U.S. envoys meet with Putin in the Kremlin after Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
Ukraine says military Starlink disrupted again as US envoys meet Putin in Moscow

en.title: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow after Abu Dhabi talks, Ukrainian president cites Starlink disruptions
en.dek: US special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff traveled to the Kremlin on November 12 after Abu Dhabi talks, Ukrainian president says Starlink disruptions affect military operations, and European leaders were sidelined in Abu Dhabi.
facts: US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Putin in Moscow on November 12 after talks in Abu Dhabi
Ukrainian president says Starlink disruptions affect military operations
European leaders were sidelined in Abu Dhabi, says Kyiv Post
Russian president reportedly proposes humanitarian mission for eastern Kostyantynivka
German outlet Die Zeit confirms Putin made the humanitarian mission proposal
Ukrainian outlets report outrage over renewed Starshield throttling
body: US special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff traveled to the Kremlin to meet Putin on November 12 after talks in Abu Dhabi, NPR reports.
Ukrainian president says Starlink disruptions affect military operations, BBC reports.
European leaders were sidelined in Abu Dhabi, Kyiv Post says.
Russian president reportedly offers US envoys a humanitarian mission for eastern Kostyantynivka, German outlet Die Zeit says.
Ukrainian outlets report outrage over renewed Starshield throttling following the Starlink disruptions.
The series of meetings and proposals reflects ongoing diplomatic activity around the conflict as both sides seek leverage.
en.context: US envoys have been engaging Russian officials following recent diplomatic efforts in Abu Dhabi, while Ukrainian officials report technical disruptions to communication systems supplied by US companies.
